name: dsh-web-search-plus
description: SillyTavern-style web search for DeepSeek Harness, configured once in dsh Settings: off / let the model decide (tool call served by Serper, SerpApi, Tavily, Brave, SearXNG or DeepSeek official) / search on trigger words / use the API provider's own search (OpenRouter :online, billed per search); a web_fetch page reader (public addresses only) built from the core's own tool definition with an address-pinned transport; optional page visiting that opens the top results and hands their article text to the model (built-in extraction, or a local trafilatura service); keys through the dsh credential store.
